evals.name: comparator-inflation-caught-not-shipped
evals.given: The scoring tool's exact tier normalizes numerics through a 6-significant-figure format, so 1000000 and 1000001 compare equal and every lane score is inflated.
evals.when: The adversarial review of the comparator probes normalization with constructed near-equal value pairs.
evals.then: The collapse is filed as a comparator bug; the comparator is fixed to precision-lossless canonicalization and re-run — the scores are never hand-adjusted.

evals.name: residual-resolves-to-real-lane-loss
evals.given: The docx lane scores 0.957 recall; the bag diff shows the oracle-only tokens are bullets and auto-numbering (render-time artifacts from numbering.xml).
evals.then: The residual is classified as a real lane loss (numbered-list structure absent from the extract) and recorded in the coverage ledger — not waved off as engine noise.

evals.name: display-rounding-goes-to-tolerant-tier
evals.given: A formula workbook scores 0.51 exact because the oracle exports display-rounded values while the lane stores full precision.
evals.then: The exact tier keeps the honest 0.51 with the display-rounding attribution; the display-tolerant tier reports the apples-to-apples figure; neither number is presented as the other.

evals.name: partial-independence-stated
evals.given: The only available oracle for a format is a second pure-python library that shares the same container-parsing dependency as the lane.
evals.then: The shared layer is named explicitly (container parsing shared, higher-level decoding independent) so the reader can weigh what the agreement proves — the oracle is not presented as fully independent.

evals.name: scaffold-stripped-positionally
evals.given: The lane's extract carries a provenance header and a 'Subject: ' prefix, and the document body contains quoted-history lines that also start with 'Subject:'.
evals.when: The ours-side text is prepared for comparison.
evals.then: Only the positionally-identified scaffold lines are stripped; the look-alike body lines are preserved — pattern-based stripping that ate them is detected as a recall residual and fixed in the comparator.

evals.name: ace-golden-eval-kept-out-of-index
evals.given: A golden retrieval question is proposed as both an eval case and an ingestable chunk.
evals.when: The independent oracle validation gate checks the fixture.
evals.then: The case is rejected because #61 keeps golden eval cases outside ingest paths and chunk stores.
